description: This file defines an abstract class 'StaticContentData' that contains common attributes and methods for handling static content data, such as filename and content type, within a content management context.

classes.name: StaticContentData
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common attributes and behaviors for static content data, including filename and content type management.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with this static content.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for this static content.

methods.name: getFileContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the static content as a String.

methods.name: setFileContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the static content as a String.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the FileContentType enumeration value for the static content.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the FileContentType enumeration value for the static content.
